text: Petra Văideanu (née Mihalache; born August 24, 1965) is a retired Romanian heptathlete. She placed 22nd at the 1991 World Championships, finished second at the 1992 European Indoor Championships, secured sixth place at the 1993 World Indoor Championships, came in twelfth at the 1993 World Championships, and ranked eighth at the 1994 European Indoor Championships.
